summary: IcebergBackend — single entry point for Iceberg catalog connections. Accepts a catalog type string ('rest') and config kwargs. Dispatches to a concrete IcebergConnectionBase subclass via _CATALOG_REGISTRY. connect()/close() are fluent and idempotent. Delegates all inspection to the underlying connection.
extension_points: _CATALOG_REGISTRY dict — add a new catalog type by registering a new IcebergConnectionBase subclass
lifecycle_notes: IcebergBackend requires optional pyiceberg dependency — guarded at package root import.
New-style IcebergBackend takes **kwargs directly; IcebergConnectionBase still uses SettingsParameters.
documentation_hooks: Catalog type registry and how to add a new catalog type belongs in extension-author docs
Optional dependency install instructions (pip install mountainash-data[pyiceberg])
risks: inspect_table return type is annotated as t.Any instead of TableInfo — protocol conformance gap
open_questions: Should inspect_table/inspect_namespace/inspect_catalog be typed as the concrete inspection model types rather than t.Any?

evidence.detail: IcebergBackend conditionally imported with try/except ImportError
